rationale: Two separate groupings (provider_specialty, network_status) on the claim-level fields, as the task asks for each comparison on its own; all five requested metrics; denial-rate denominator restricted to adjudicated claims per the portfolio definition, with numerator/denominator emitted per rate; min_group_size=30 flags unstable groups. join_check on medical_claims.rendering_npi->providers.provider_npi verifies cardinality, unmatched keys and right-key uniqueness before the ranking relies on the directory join (manifest shows many_to_one, 150/150 NPIs matched, 0 unmatched). provider_ranking by claim_count, top 10, min_claims=0 so the list is literally the ten rendering providers with the most claims, with specialty and network_status pulled from the directory. provider_join is omitted: join_check already covers the required verification and a pre-merge could collide with the claim-level network_status column the group comparison must use. Report prints every rate as numerator/denominator, cites artifacts per bullet, and carries synthetic-data, descriptive-only, association-not-causation and small-group caveats.
